svg.text: Direction: Ramp Up, Ramp Down, or Ramp Up & Down (up in the first half, back down in the second).
Enable Plateaus: splits each ramp into Steps, each holding its speed for the Plateau Ratio.
Tacho Noise: jitter and dropouts, applied only to the Tacho_Master column of the exported file.
The preview keeps the clean profile, so the noise is not visible here.
